label: Amazon SES
terms_note: Automation allowed with IAM credentials (SigV4-signed REST or SMTP interface). Every new account starts in the SANDBOX per region: only verified recipient addresses / domains or the mailbox simulator, 200 messages per 24 h, 1 message per second, suppression-list bulk actions disabled; production access is requested in the console or via `aws sesv2 put-account-details --production-access-enabled --mail-type TRANSACTIONAL|MARKETING --website-url …` and AWS Support answers within 24 h (the requester acknowledges sending only to people who asked and having a bounce / complaint process). From / Source / Return-Path identities must always be verified. Pay per volume sent and received.

sdks: AWS SDKs for SendEmail (sesv2): Python boto3, JavaScript v3, Java v2, Go v2, .NET v4, PHP v3, Ruby v3, Kotlin, C++; AWS CLI v2 (docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/APIReference-V2/API_SendEmail.html)

endpoints.purpose: bounce / complaint / delivery / open / click events → our webhook

endpoints.call: Receipt rule set + rule (actions: S3, SNS, Lambda, WorkMail, bounce, stop) + MX record
endpoints.notes: only in regions in the AWS General Reference inbound-endpoints table; Spamhaus / SES block lists applied

reference.limits: - Sandbox (per region): recipients must be verified (or the mailbox simulator), **200 messages / 24 h**, **1 message / second**, suppression bulk actions disabled. Production access: console or `aws sesv2 put-account-details`; AWS Support first response within 24 h; requester confirms opt-in-only sending and a bounce / complaint process. - Errors: `AccountSuspendedException`, `SendingPausedException`, `MailFromDomainNotVerifiedException`, `MessageRejected`, `LimitExceededException`, `TooManyRequestsException` (429). - Pay per volume sent and received. SES may accept-but-not-send (virus attach

config_fields.name: region
config_fields.help: AWS Region of your SES account, e.g. us-east-1, eu-west-1 (the endpoint is email.<region>.amazonaws.com).

config_fields.name: from_address
config_fields.help: Verified sender identity (address or an address on a verified domain) used as FromEmailAddress.

fields.name: access_key_id
fields.help: AWS access key id of an IAM principal allowed ses:SendEmail and ses:GetAccount.

fields.name: secret_access_key
fields.help: The matching AWS secret access key; used only to derive the SigV4 signing key.

fields.name: session_token
fields.help: Session token when the keys are temporary STS credentials (sent as X-Amz-Security-Token).

me.note: GetAccount (GET /v2/email/account): sending status (SendingEnabled, ProductionAccessEnabled = out of the sandbox), SendQuota {Max24HourSend, MaxSendRate, SentLast24Hours} and enforcement status in this Region.

send.note: SendEmail (POST /v2/email/outbound-emails) sends a Simple plain-text message from the configured verified sender to one address; always pass `subject`. In the SES sandbox the recipient must be verified too.

not_offered.list_inbound: SES v2 has no API to read received mail: receiving is configured as receipt rules that deliver to S3, SNS or Lambda (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/receiving-email.html); the API reference (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/APIReference-V2/API_Operations.html) has no mailbox read operation.
not_offered.get_thread: SES is a send-only service with no conversation or thread store (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/APIReference-V2/API_Operations.html).
not_offered.reply: Replies need the original message's Message-ID/References headers, which SES does not store (no inbound read API, https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/APIReference-V2/API_Operations.html); use send with the reply address.
not_offered.mark_read: SES keeps no read state for messages (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/APIReference-V2/API_Operations.html).

adapter.terms: Every SES v2 request is signed with AWS Signature Version 4 (service 'ses', the configured Region; https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_sigv.html). New accounts start in the sandbox (verified recipients only, 200 messages/24 h).

live_check.notes: requires access_key_id, secret_access_key, region, from_address; started, listed tools and answered a clean auth_error naming the variables
